locked.name: Locked
locked.explanation: Meeting the requirements unlocks this element

maximum-owned.name: Maximum Owned
maximum-owned.explanation: Items cannot be held beyond this number

maximum-execution.name: Maximum Executions
maximum-execution.explanation: Actions cannot be executed beyond this number

purchase-limit.name: Purchase Limit
purchase-limit.explanation: The upper limit on how many times it can be purchased

purchasable-count.name: Purchasable
purchasable-count.explanation: How many more times it can be purchased

navigation.name: Navigation
navigation.explanation: You can also swipe to move between columns. A "Top" button appears at the bottom left of the screen.

navigation-column.name: Column
navigation-column.explanation: The position of this column and the total number of columns, including those off screen

selected.name: Selected
selected.explanation: The total of the items chosen to be sold

activity.name: Activity
activity.explanation: A list of executable actions grouped by category

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.explanation: A list of the items you hold, grouped by category

status.name: Status
status.explanation: Shows the current state, such as the modifiers applied to a category

ability.name: Ability
ability.explanation: A list of the skills that can trigger now, grouped by category

overview.name: Overview
overview.explanation: Shows an overview of this world and the console running it

estimated-playing-time.name: Estimated Playing Time
estimated-playing-time.explanation: The time the author estimates it takes to clear this world

default-language.name: Default Language
default-language.explanation: The language the world displays first

language-change-enable-general.name: Changeable
language-change-enable-general.explanation: The display language can be changed on the settings screen

offline-max-hours.name: Maximum Offline Hours
offline-max-hours.explanation: The upper limit on the offline time reflected in the game progress

max-category-level.name: Maximum Category Level
max-category-level.explanation: The highest level reachable in each category

level-common-ratio.name: Required Experience Growth
level-common-ratio.explanation: Shows how much the experience required for the next level increases with each level up

property-ratio.name: Property Influence
property-ratio.explanation: The multiplier applied to a property for every 10 levels of difference. At 1 the level difference has no effect

default-action-stamina.name: Default Action Stamina
default-action-stamina.explanation: The base combat value common to all actions. Individual combat values are added to it

console.name: Console
console.explanation: This game runs on the "Idle RPG" console system. It is published free to the public, so anyone can create a game.

statistics.name: Statistics
statistics.explanation: Shows the totals recorded through play

coin.name: Coin
coin.explanation: An item used as the currency for trading

play-time.name: Play Time
play-time.explanation: The date and time play started, and how long you have been playing

play-started.name: Started
play-started.explanation: The date and time play started

play-duration.name: Elapsed Time
play-duration.explanation: The time elapsed since play started

coins-earned.name: Coins Earned
coins-earned.explanation: The total amount of each coin earned so far

unique-count.name: Unique Count
unique-count.explanation: The number of kinds of items that can be held

max-capacity.name: Capacity
max-capacity.explanation: The current upper limit on the number of item kinds that can be held

max-queue.name: Queue
max-queue.explanation: The current upper limit on the number of actions the queue can hold

statistics-category.name: Category
statistics-category.explanation: How much of this world's categories have been unlocked

statistics-action.name: Action
statistics-action.explanation: How much of this world's actions have been unlocked

statistics-item.name: Item
statistics-item.explanation: How much of this world's items have been unlocked

statistics-event.name: Event
statistics-event.explanation: Shows how much of this world's events have been unlocked

count-unlocked.name: Unlocked
count-unlocked.explanation: The number unlocked so far out of the total

level-total.name: Total Level
level-total.explanation: The sum of the levels of all categories and its maximum

count-performed.name: Performed
count-performed.explanation: The total number of times actions have been performed so far

count-earned.name: Earned
count-earned.explanation: The total number of items earned so far

count-triggered.name: Triggered
count-triggered.explanation: The total number of times events have occurred so far

debug.name: Debug
debug.explanation: Provides tools for testing the world. Available only in debug mode.

acceleration.name: Acceleration
acceleration.explanation: Speeds up the passage of time in the game. Take care: raising the speed too far while actions take little time can outrun the processing and freeze or crash the app.

skip.name: Skip
skip.explanation: Advances the in-game time all at once without waiting

skip-hour.name: Skip One Hour
skip-hour.explanation: Advances the game by one hour at once. The progress is handled the same way as while you are away, and the result is shown in a notification.

adjustment.name: Value Adjustment
adjustment.explanation: Increases or decreases the number of items held and the category levels

adjustment-category.name: Category
adjustment-category.explanation: Adjusts the level of a category. For example, setting it to +5 raises the level by 5.

adjustment-action.name: Action
adjustment-action.explanation: This increases or decreases the number of times that action has been performed. The rewards gained by completing the action are not reflected, however.

adjustment-item.name: Item
adjustment-item.explanation: Increases or decreases the number of items held

adjustment-id.name: ID
adjustment-id.explanation: Specifies the ID of the target kind. Left blank, the addition or subtraction applies to every ID.

adjustment-count.name: Quantity
adjustment-count.explanation: The quantity to add or subtract. The sign specifies whether it is plus or minus.

adjustment-adjust.name: Adjust
adjustment-adjust.explanation: Runs the adjustment under the specified conditions

iconify.name: Iconify
iconify.explanation: This game uses the icon sets provided by Iconify. Our thanks go to everyone who took part in making them.

level.name: Level
level.explanation: The proficiency in this category. It rises as experience accumulates

category-experience.name: Experience
category-experience.explanation: The progress toward the next level. It increases when an action is performed

standalone.name: Standalone
standalone.explanation: Runs on its own, regardless of how actions in other categories are progressing

standalone-yes.name: Passive
standalone-yes.explanation: Runs on its own, regardless of how actions in other categories are progressing

standalone-no.name: Active
standalone-no.explanation: Shares an execution slot with the other categories. Only one action can run at a time, and starting another action sends the current one to the queue

action.name: Action
action.explanation: Something that can be performed in this category

actions.name: Action List
actions.explanation: A list of the actions belonging to this category

attribute.name: Attribute
attribute.explanation: The attribute unique to this action. The category's properties apply to this action's attribute, and experience is granted to the attribute as well.

persistent.name: Continuous
persistent.explanation: Runs the action over and over, granting a reward each time the action is completed

single.name: Single
single.explanation: It stops after running once and does not repeat. The progress is saved even if it is interrupted partway.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.explanation: Every time an action is performed, the stamina of the player and of the target decreases. Running the target's stamina out is a win, and running the player's stamina out is a game over. Nothing is lost on a game over, but every action in progress is interrupted.

act.name: Act
act.explanation: Starts and stops this action and shows how far it has progressed

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.explanation: Finalizes the result of the progress that has finished

reserve.name: Reserve
reserve.explanation: Adds this action to the reservation queue so that it runs in turn

reorder.name: Reorder
reorder.explanation: Applies the chosen execution count and execution order to this action in the queue. Moving the running action to 1 or later stops it and returns it to standby.

position.name: Execution Order
position.explanation: Chooses this action's position in the queue. 0 is the head, which pushes the running action back and runs this one right away. 1 and later wait at that position.

now.name: Now
now.explanation: Places this action at the head of the queue and runs it right away

clear.name: Clear
clear.explanation: Deletes every reservation in the queue, including the one being executed

acquisition-failure.name: Acquisition Failure
acquisition-failure.explanation: Rewards marked [On Failure] in their description are obtained only when the action fails. The percentage shown is the chance of obtaining them.

item.name: Item
item.explanation: The belongings related to this category

items.name: Item List
items.explanation: A list of the items belonging to this category

selling-items.name: Item List
selling-items.explanation: A list of the items you hold that have a selling price set

normal.name: Normal
normal.explanation: A normal item that can be owned, equipped and traded

capacity.name: Capacity
capacity.explanation: Affects the number of item kinds that can be held at once

queue.name: Queue
queue.explanation: The number of actions that can be put in the queue (the reservation slots for actions)

recovery.name: Recovery
recovery.explanation: The amount of stamina recovered at the start of combat

unique.name: Unique
unique.explanation: An item that can be owned only one of

equipment-type.name: Equipment Type
equipment-type.explanation: The equipment type of the item

unnecessary-item.name: Always Active
unnecessary-item.explanation: The effect triggers just by holding it. The effect is multiplied by the number held.

consumable-item.name: Consumable
consumable-item.explanation: Equipping it brings out the effect, but it is consumed every time an action is performed (it is not consumed on each stamina turn)

selling.name: Selling
selling.explanation: Sells the items you own in bulk, chosen from a list

kind.name: Kinds
kind.explanation: The number of item kinds chosen

selling-value.name: Selling Price
selling-value.explanation: The price when selling that item

queue-full.name: Queue Full
queue-full.explanation: The queue is full, including what is running

already-queued.name: Already Queued
already-queued.explanation: That action is already in the queue

unmatched-requirements.name: Requirements Unmet
unmatched-requirements.explanation: The requirements needed to run it are not met

unmatched-equip-requirements.name: Equip Requirements Unmet
unmatched-equip-requirements.explanation: The requirements needed to equip it are not met

unequippable-item.name: Unequippable Type
unequippable-item.explanation: This item is of a type that cannot be equipped

purchase-limit-reached.name: Purchase Limit Reached
purchase-limit-reached.explanation: The purchase limit has been reached

completed-maximum.name: Completion Limit
completed-maximum.explanation: The completed count has reached the limit

relationship-items.name: Related Items
relationship-items.explanation: A list of the items involved in the category's actions

group.name: Group
group.explanation: A classification that bundles categories, actions and items across each other

skill.name: Skill
skill.explanation: Triggering it during combat adjusts the combat values for that turn only

skills.name: Skill List
skills.explanation: A list of the skills this element has

no-ability.name: No Skills
no-ability.explanation: There are no skills that can trigger now

property.name: Property
property.explanation: A value that affects the result of an action

calculation.name: Calculation
calculation.explanation: The property values reflected in the action and their breakdown

properties.name: Property List
properties.explanation: A list of the properties belonging to this category

attack.name: Attack
attack.explanation: The damage from the player to the target

defence.name: Defence
defence.explanation: The damage from the target to the player

accuracy.name: Accuracy
accuracy.explanation: The probability of the player dealing damage to the target

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.explanation: The probability of taking damage from the target

restore.name: Recovery
restore.explanation: The amount recovered when the target's stamina runs out and play moves on to the next action

speed.name: Speed
speed.explanation: Affects the speed of an action

chance.name: Success Rate
chance.explanation: On a failure, neither the reward nor the experience is gained

experience.name: Experience
experience.explanation: Affects the experience gained from an action

base-value.name: Base Value
base-value.explanation: The value specific to this game or action

level-gap.name: Level Gap
level-gap.explanation: For the numeric calculation, see the "Level" block

reflected-value.name: Reflected Value
reflected-value.explanation: The final value calculated from the "Base Value" and the "Level Gap"

level-gap-property.name: Level Gap Property
level-gap-property.explanation: The "Level Gap" value is the sum of the values in this block

level-gap-category.name: Level Gap Category
level-gap-category.explanation: The player's category level minus this action's level. For "Experience", however, it is the other way around.

level-gap-action.name: Level Gap Action
level-gap-action.explanation: When the progress type is "Stamina", the value set by this action itself

level-gap-item.name: Level Gap Item
level-gap-item.explanation: This is the adjustment from items that are equipped, or that take effect without being equipped

no-status.name: No Status
no-status.explanation: There is no property adjustment in any category

timing-tasked.name: Requirements Met
timing-tasked.explanation: Occurs the moment the requirements are met

timing-comebacked.name: Comeback
timing-comebacked.explanation: Occurs when you come back after being away offline for a while

timing-gameovered.name: Game Over
timing-gameovered.explanation: Occurs when your stamina runs out during battle

timing-welcomed.name: First Launch
timing-welcomed.explanation: Occurs when you open this world for the first time

timing-completed.name: Completion
timing-completed.explanation: Occurs when every category reaches its maximum level

timing-obtained.name: Obtained
timing-obtained.explanation: Occurs when a one-off action is completed

comebacked.name: Welcome Back
comebacked.explanation: Welcome back! Here is your progress while you were away:

gameovered.name: Game Over
gameovered.explanation: Game over. Your progress has been reset.

completed.name: Completion
completed.explanation: Congratulations! You have completed every category.

achieved.name: Achieved
achieved.explanation: Whether the task has been achieved

receive.name: Claim
receive.explanation: Claim the reward for this task

received.name: Claimed
received.explanation: The reward for this task has been claimed

hidden.name: Hidden
hidden.explanation: This column is hidden once you check its contents

task.name: Task
task.explanation: A challenge that gives a reward when achieved

tasks.name: Task List
tasks.explanation: The list of tasks set for this category

missions.name: Missions
missions.explanation: The list of tasks from every category and their achievement status

config.name: Settings
config.explanation: Change this game's settings and manage its save data

auto-clear-queue.name: Auto-Clear Queue
auto-clear-queue.explanation: When you long-press an action to quick-start it, the whole queue including the running action is cleared before that action is executed

display.name: Display
display.explanation: Change how the game is displayed on screen

language.name: Language
language.explanation: Change the language used for display

selected-language.name: Selected Language
selected-language.explanation: The language currently used for display

language-change-enable.name: Changeable
language-change-enable.explanation: The display language can be changed

language-change-unenable.name: Not Changeable
language-change-unenable.explanation: There is no other language available for display

category-shortcut.name: Show Lists With Category
category-shortcut.explanation: When you open a category, also show the action list or the item list

switching-list.name: Switch Lists by Group
switching-list.explanation: In the list columns within a category, expand only one group at a time

showing-hint.name: Hints
showing-hint.explanation: Show explanations of how to operate the game

showing-navigation.name: Navigation
showing-navigation.explanation: Show the buttons for moving between columns. Even without the buttons, you can swipe to move between columns.

performance.name: Performance
performance.explanation: Adjust the behavior to suit your device

performing-highly.name: High-Frequency Updates
performing-highly.explanation: Increase the update frequency. Turning this off is recommended if the game runs slowly. It does not affect the execution time of each action.

data.name: Data
data.explanation: Save, load, and delete the progress data for this world

export-game.name: Export
export-game.explanation: The game's progress data has been exported

import-game.name: Import
import-game.explanation: The game's progress data has been imported

import-mistake.name: Load Failed
import-mistake.explanation: Failed to load the game data

reset-game.name: Reset Game
reset-game.explanation: Delete all progress data for this world. This cannot be undone. Make sure you really want to delete the file, then type "DELETE" in the input field.

reset-alert.name: Reset Confirmation
reset-alert.explanation: Resetting the game erases all data. Do you really want to reset the game?

reset-debug-mode.name: Debug Mode
reset-debug-mode.explanation: In debug mode, no input in the confirmation field is required

restart.name: Restart
restart.explanation: Reload the console. Use this to check whether the build has been replaced.

hint-language-scope.name: Hint Language Scope
hint-language-scope.explanation: Only the language of the interface changes

hint-language-fallback.name: Hint Language Fallback
hint-language-fallback.explanation: Text without a translation is shown in the default language

hint-event-capacity.name: Hint Event Capacity
hint-event-capacity.explanation: You cannot claim a reward while you are at the limit for the number of types you can hold. Make room, then claim it again

hint-event-closing.name: Hint Event Closing
hint-event-closing.explanation: It closes when you press Checked or slide to the column on the left

hint-group-meaning.name: Hint Group Meaning
hint-group-meaning.explanation: A group is a classification that bundles categories, actions, and items together

hint-group-exclusive.name: Hint Group Exclusive
hint-group-exclusive.explanation: Only one item can be equipped per group

hint-group-index.name: Hint Group Index
hint-group-index.explanation: The value on the right is the level for a category, the required level for an action, and the quantity held for an item

hint-debug-mode.name: Hint Debug Mode
hint-debug-mode.explanation: Shown only when launched in debug mode. It does not appear in normal play

hint-debug-acceleration.name: Hint Debug Acceleration
hint-debug-acceleration.explanation: The acceleration setting is saved in the progress data, but it only takes effect while in debug mode

hint-config-settings.name: Hint Config Settings
hint-config-settings.explanation: You can change the controls, the display, and the processing load. Settings are saved as part of the progress data and carried over into exported data

hint-config-data.name: Hint Config Data
hint-config-data.explanation: Progress data is saved on this device for each world. An exported file can only be loaded by the same version of the same world

hint-statistics-progress.name: Hint Statistics Progress
hint-statistics-progress.explanation: You can check the totals for play time and coins earned, and how many item slots and queue slots you can hold right now

hint-statistics-unlocked.name: Hint Statistics Unlocked
hint-statistics-unlocked.explanation: The unlocked counts for categories, actions, items, and events use the world's total as the denominator, including those you have not found yet

hint-statistics-opening.name: Hint Statistics Opening
hint-statistics-opening.explanation: Tapping coins, capacity, the queue, or a category in the breakdown opens that screen

hint-overview-world.name: Hint Overview World
hint-overview-world.explanation: You can check the identity of the world, such as its author, version, and estimated play time, along with the settings shared by the whole world, such as the default language, the maximum offline hours, the category level cap, and how steeply the required experience grows

hint-overview-console.name: Hint Overview Console
hint-overview-console.explanation: The console is the runtime that loads and runs a world. It has its own version and update date, separate from the world

hint-properties-meaning.name: Hint Properties Meaning
hint-properties-meaning.explanation: A property is an element that affects the execution of actions

hint-properties-resource.name: Hint Properties Resource
hint-properties-resource.explanation: The tags listed below are the items contributing to that value, with their breakdown

hint-properties-crossing.name: Hint Properties Crossing
hint-properties-crossing.explanation: An item from another category also takes effect if this category is its target

hint-trade-availability.name: Hint Trade Availability
hint-trade-availability.explanation: Without a price, the buy and sell slots do not appear at all. Locked items cannot be traded either

hint-trade-capacity.name: Hint Trade Capacity
hint-trade-capacity.explanation: When the item slots are full, you cannot buy a type you do not hold yet. You can still buy more of what you have

hint-trade-limit.name: Hint Trade Limit
hint-trade-limit.explanation: Item slots and queue slots are bought one at a time, and the price rises with each purchase. Some worlds also cap the number of purchases (rewards are not counted)

hint-trade-selling.name: Hint Trade Selling
hint-trade-selling.explanation: Equipment that drops to zero after being sold is unequipped automatically

hint-items-meaning.name: Hint Items Meaning
hint-items-meaning.explanation: An item is an element for the things you hold, such as equipment, consumables, and valuables

hint-items-list.name: Hint Items List
hint-items-list.explanation: The list of items you can hold in this category

hint-items-equipping.name: Hint Items Equipping
hint-items-equipping.explanation: Long-press to switch whether an item is equipped

hint-items-exclusive.name: Hint Items Exclusive
hint-items-exclusive.explanation: Only one item can be equipped per group

hint-items-locked.name: Hint Items Locked
hint-items-locked.explanation: An item whose unlock requirements are not met is shown with a strikethrough, and its explanation and quantity are hidden

hint-items-relationship.name: Hint Items Relationship
hint-items-relationship.explanation: Related shows the actions that obtain the item and the actions that consume it

hint-item-meaning.name: Hint Item Meaning
hint-item-meaning.explanation: An item is an element for the things you hold, such as equipment, consumables, and valuables

hint-item-exclusive.name: Hint Item Exclusive
hint-item-exclusive.explanation: Only one item can be equipped per group. Items in different groups can be equipped at the same time even within the same category

hint-item-equipping.name: Hint Item Equipping
hint-item-equipping.explanation: The Equip button appears only for an item you hold, whose requirements you meet, and which the category accepts as equipment

hint-item-locked.name: Hint Item Locked
hint-item-locked.explanation: An item whose unlock requirements are not met is shown with a strikethrough, and its explanation and quantity are hidden

hint-act-count.name: Hint Act Count
hint-act-count.explanation: The ∞ on the far right keeps executing until it stops at the limit of the resources or of the total number of executions

hint-act-position.name: Hint Act Position
hint-act-position.explanation: In the execution order, 0 means execute now and 1 or later means waiting. An interrupted execution keeps its remaining count, returns to waiting, and resumes later

hint-act-queue.name: Hint Act Queue
hint-act-queue.explanation: A reservation goes through even when the queue is full, and the overflow is discarded from the end of the waiting list. A reservation that cannot be executed when its turn comes is discarded as well

hint-act-opening.name: Hint Act Opening
hint-act-opening.explanation: Pressing the target row or the skill row opens that column

hint-calculation-ratio.name: Hint Calculation Ratio
hint-calculation-ratio.explanation: The applied value is not added or subtracted; a multiplier is applied for every 10 levels of difference. Attack and experience increase, while defence and the required time decrease

hint-calculation-weight.name: Hint Calculation Weight
hint-calculation-weight.explanation: How strongly it works differs from property to property

hint-calculation-odds.name: Hint Calculation Odds
hint-calculation-odds.explanation: Accuracy, evasion, success rate, and recovery never go below 0% or above 100%

hint-queue-removing.name: Hint Queue Removing
hint-queue-removing.explanation: Long-press a bar to remove it from the queue. The first one is running, so it stops and the next one begins.

hint-actions-meaning.name: Hint Actions Meaning
hint-actions-meaning.explanation: An action is something you execute to gain experience and rewards

hint-actions-list.name: Hint Actions List
hint-actions-list.explanation: The list of actions you can execute in this category

hint-actions-executing.name: Hint Actions Executing
hint-actions-executing.explanation: Long-press to switch whether an action is executing

hint-actions-exclusive.name: Hint Actions Exclusive
hint-actions-exclusive.explanation: Only one action can be executed within a single category

hint-actions-parallel.name: Hint Actions Parallel
hint-actions-parallel.explanation: Depending on the category (standalone set to passive), actions from several categories can progress at the same time

hint-actions-locked.name: Hint Actions Locked
hint-actions-locked.explanation: An action whose unlock requirements are not met is shown with a strikethrough, and its explanation is hidden

hint-action-meaning.name: Hint Action Meaning
hint-action-meaning.explanation: An action is something you execute to gain experience and rewards

hint-action-attribute.name: Hint Action Attribute
hint-action-attribute.explanation: The attribute is the category that receives the experience. It can differ from the category the action belongs to, and the level required to execute is judged there as well

hint-action-executing.name: Hint Action Executing
hint-action-executing.explanation: Long-press the execute row to switch between starting and stopping

hint-action-resource.name: Hint Action Resource
hint-action-resource.explanation: The things listed under "Requirement" are consumed on every execution. A percentage is the chance of being consumed

hint-action-locked.name: Hint Action Locked
hint-action-locked.explanation: An action whose unlock requirements are not met is shown with a strikethrough, and its explanation is hidden

hint-skills-list.name: Hint Skills List
hint-skills-list.explanation: Lists the skills held by the items of each category

hint-skills-chance.name: Hint Skills Chance
hint-skills-chance.explanation: The percentage is the chance of activation

hint-skills-opponent.name: Hint Skills Opponent
hint-skills-opponent.explanation: The skills held by the action side can be checked in the action column

hint-skill-meaning.name: Hint Skill Meaning
hint-skill-meaning.explanation: A skill is an element that adjusts the battle values for that turn alone when it activates during battle

hint-skill-chance.name: Hint Skill Chance
hint-skill-chance.explanation: Activation is drawn each turn, with at most one per turn for your side and for the opponent. If another skill is drawn first, it does not occur as often as the displayed chance

hint-skill-restore.name: Hint Skill Restore
hint-skill-restore.explanation: Recovery alone does not take effect on that turn; it is applied together in the recovery after the battle is settled

hint-tasks-meaning.name: Hint Tasks Meaning
hint-tasks-meaning.explanation: A task is an event that is achieved when its requirements are met. You claim the reward yourself

hint-tasks-unclaimed.name: Hint Tasks Unclaimed
hint-tasks-unclaimed.explanation: A task whose reward has not been claimed is marked with a ribbon. Open it and press Claim

hint-tasks-capacity.name: Hint Tasks Capacity
hint-tasks-capacity.explanation: You cannot claim a reward while you are at the limit for the number of types you can hold. Make room, then claim it again

hint-category-meaning.name: Hint Category Meaning
hint-category-meaning.explanation: A category is a unit that gathers actions, items, properties, skills, and tasks

hint-category-level.name: Hint Category Level
hint-category-level.explanation: The level rises with the experience gained by executing actions

hint-category-holding.name: Hint Category Holding
hint-category-holding.explanation: Long-press to switch between the progress bar and the equipment bar

hint-category-equipment.name: Hint Category Equipment
hint-category-equipment.explanation: One equipment slot is provided per group

hint-status-meaning.name: Hint Status Meaning
hint-status-meaning.explanation: A property is a numeric adjustment that affects the result of executing an action

hint-status-property.name: Hint Status Property
hint-status-property.explanation: Only the adjustments from items are listed here; depending on the action you execute, further adjustments such as skills also apply

hint-status-stacking.name: Hint Status Stacking
hint-status-stacking.explanation: For an item that does not need to be equipped, the adjustment grows in proportion to the quantity held

hint-inventory-meaning.name: Hint Inventory Meaning
hint-inventory-meaning.explanation: An item is an element for the things you hold, such as equipment, consumables, and valuables

hint-inventory-equipping.name: Hint Inventory Equipping
hint-inventory-equipping.explanation: Long-press a bar to switch equipment

hint-inventory-capacity.name: Hint Inventory Capacity
hint-inventory-capacity.explanation: Item slots count the number of item types, not the number of items

hint-selling-list.name: Hint Selling List
hint-selling-list.explanation: Only the items you hold that have a selling price are listed

hint-selling-amount.name: Hint Selling Amount
hint-selling-amount.explanation: Selecting one puts your entire quantity up for sale. The value is the total

hint-selling-unequip.name: Hint Selling Unequip
hint-selling-unequip.explanation: Equipment that drops to zero after being sold is unequipped automatically

hint-activity-meaning.name: Hint Activity Meaning
hint-activity-meaning.explanation: An action is something you execute to gain experience and rewards

hint-activity-executing.name: Hint Activity Executing
hint-activity-executing.explanation: Long-press a bar to switch execution

hint-activity-index.name: Hint Activity Index
hint-activity-index.explanation: Lv.n is the level required for that action

hint-ability-meaning.name: Hint Ability Meaning
hint-ability-meaning.explanation: A skill is an element that adjusts the battle values for that turn alone when it activates during battle

hint-ability-source.name: Hint Ability Source
hint-ability-source.explanation: Listed are the skills held by equipped items and by items you hold that do not need to be equipped

hint-ability-chance.name: Hint Ability Chance
hint-ability-chance.explanation: The percentage is the chance of activation

hint-missions-meaning.name: Hint Missions Meaning
hint-missions-meaning.explanation: A task is an event that is achieved when its requirements are met. You claim the reward yourself

hint-missions-completed.name: Hint Missions Completed
hint-missions-completed.explanation: An achieved task is marked with a check. Once achieved, it stays achieved even if the requirements are no longer met

hint-missions-unclaimed.name: Hint Missions Unclaimed
hint-missions-unclaimed.explanation: A task whose reward has not been claimed is marked with a ribbon. Open it and press Claim

hint-property-meaning.name: Hint Property Meaning
hint-property-meaning.explanation: A property is a numeric adjustment that affects the result of executing an action

hint-property-scope.name: Hint Property Scope
hint-property-scope.explanation: Opening it from a category shows the list of contributing items, from an item the list of affected categories, and from a skill only the adjustment values
